clause: Camera/creative profiles, preset browser, snapshots, defaults [STU-RAW-013]

scope.summary: Implement the profile/preset surfaces: a profile stage applied before slider edits (camera-matching/neutral render profiles + look/creative profiles from a registry); a preset browser with hover-preview + preset-amount/intensity slider + user-saved presets; Snapshots (named reappliable develop-state versions); default-settings management (per-camera-model, per-serial-number, per-ISO defaults + a develop output-profile/ICC selection); and per-adjustment/per-panel add/delete/reset-to-default with active toggles. Profiles/presets reuse the StudioSwatch/StudioColorProfile/style-registry machinery of 14.8/14.10 (a source suite's bundled pack is provenance, not a shipped asset name).
acceptance_criteria: profiles + preset browser + snapshots + defaults reusing 14.8/14.10 registries; Argus + manual
expected_tests: test: profile stage pre-slider + preset browser hover/amount + user presets
test: snapshots reappliable; per-camera/serial/ISO defaults resolve; reuses 14.8/14.10 registries (no forked asset store)

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Profiles, presets & snapshots

risk_if_missed: No profile/preset workflow; forked asset store risk.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
